scheme_name: Free Supply of Sarees and Dhothies to the Poor People
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Pondicherry by birth or have continuous residence for at least 5 years
Benefits are provided to holders of red ration cards who have registered with the area Anganwadi
benefits_summary: Two sarees, blouse pieces, lungis, and towels are provided once a year.
